source_locator: selected Results sentences on correlations, opposite perturbations, and EpCAM levels
review_notes: Codex reviewed all biological claims in the four selected Results sentences. P-values qualify their specific correlations or perturbation findings; figure pointers are evidence locators rather than graph nodes. The opposite-effects claims require the immediately preceding sentence. This is selected-passage development gold, not a full-paper recall score.
text:
The TINCR expression level was reversely correlated to serosal invasion (p = 0.001), lymph metastasis (p = 0.037), and tumour node metastasis (TNM) classification (p = 0.016), while positively correlated with differentiation degree (p = 0.017).

Stable ectopic expression of TINCR decreased not only proliferation (p < 0.001, Figure 2A, Supplementary Figure S2C) but also the migration (Figure 2B, Supplementary Figure S2D) of RKO and LoVo cells. In contrast, knockdown of TINCR in HCT116 and SW480 cells had the opposite effects (p = 0.001. Figure 2A, 2C and Supplementary Figure S2E).

Knockdown of TINCR did not change the EpCAM mRNA but downregulated the EpCAM protein levels in CRC cells (Figure 4C and 4D).
